CustomField.description: Identifier of the queueable job currently executing this chain run. Stamped at each step's progress write; the watchdog uses it to check whether a live executor still exists before recovering the chain. Shown read-only on the record page for diagnostics.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The background job currently working on this chain. The framework updates it at every step and checks it before recovering a chain that looks stuck. Managed automatically; shown for diagnostics.
CustomField.label: Current Job ID
